internal.title: Incident Summary: High Latency in Ad Service Due to CPU Saturation
internal.body:
On 2026-11-08 at 12:21 UTC, the ad service triggered a high latency alert (ServiceLatencyHigh). Diagnosis identified resource exhaustion caused by the 'adHighCpu' flag leading to CPU saturation at 98%, which correlated with increased p95 latency of 1.8 seconds. The error rate remained low, and memory and Kafka lag metrics were normal.

The mitigation involved disabling the 'adHighCpu' flag at 12:41 UTC, which promptly restored latency to normal levels (p95 latency reduced to 0.12 seconds). The incident was resolved without further impact.

Key timeline:
- 12:21 Alert received
- 12:41 Diagnosis confirmed resource exhaustion due to flag
- 12:41 Flag disabled
- 12:41 Recovery verified

Please review the postmortem for detailed analysis and lessons learned.

external.title: High Latency Issue in Ad Service Resolved
external.body: Between 12:21 and 12:41 UTC on November 8, 2026, the ad service experienced elevated latency, causing slower response times for some requests. The issue was identified and resolved by adjusting internal service configurations, restoring normal performance promptly. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.
